title: Screening and identification of covalent Nrf2 activators with alpha,beta-unsaturated imide structures.
authors: Izumi, Yasuhiko; Takeda, Norihiko; Nishimoto, Shuzo; Niimi, Honoka; Ishizu, Sayuri; Muneyasu, Natsumi; Takamatsu, Yuto; Mishiro-Sato, Emi; Kano, Keiko; Yamaki, Kouya; Yamada, Takahiro; Koyama, Yutaka; Ueda, Masafumi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过高通量筛选和共价对接研究小分子Nrf2激活剂与Keap1蛋白的共价结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1)-nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) signaling pathway is a central regulator of cellular defense mechanisms against oxidative stress. The pharmacological activation of this pathway has emerged as a promising strategy for the treatment of diseases such as neurodegeneration and inflammation. In this study, we performed a high-throughput luciferase reporter assay to screen the original compound library comprising small molecules synthesized at Kobe Pharmaceutical University. Initial screening identified KU-0016, KU-0017, and KU-0171 as moderate activators of the Nrf2 pathway. Furthermore, structural comparison revealed a common alpha,beta-unsaturated imide motif, which led to the synthesis of KU-0017-based analogs for structure-activity relationship analysis. Among them, KU-0479 exhibited potent Nrf2 activation and low cytotoxicity. Further assays demonstrated that KU-0479 increased the intracellular glutathione (GSH) levels and protected cells from hydrogen peroxide-induced oxidative damage in a GSH-dependent manner. Moreover, LC-MS analysis confirmed the formation of mono-GSH adducts, and covalent docking simulations suggested covalent binding at the Cys151 residue of Keap1. These findings highlight KU-0479 as a synthetically accessible covalent Nrf2 activator with favorable redox-modulating properties and therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）-核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）信号通路是细胞对抗氧化应激防御机制的核心调节器。该通路的药理学激活已成为治疗神经退行性疾病和炎症等疾病的一种有前景的策略。在本研究中，我们采用高通量荧光素酶报告基因检测法，对神户药科大学合成的包含小分子的原始化合物库进行了筛选。初步筛选鉴定出KU-0016、KU-0017和KU-0171为Nrf2通路的中等激活剂。此外，结构比较揭示了一个共同的α,β-不饱和酰亚胺基序，这促使合成了基于KU-0017的类似物以进行构效关系分析。其中，KU-0479表现出强效的Nrf2激活作用和低细胞毒性。进一步实验表明，KU-0479增加了细胞内谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平，并以GSH依赖性方式保护细胞免受过氧化氢诱导的氧化损伤。此外，LC-MS分析确认了单GSH加合物的形成，共价对接模拟提示其与Keap1的Cys151残基发生共价结合。这些发现凸显了KU-0479作为一种可合成获取的共价Nrf2激活剂，具有有利的氧化还原调节特性和治疗潜力。
